entity_properties.context_details: This level is very hard if you don't have fresh in mind the idea about putting stuff in the endpoint so you can swap with it (like in wizard_finesse), and it's enjoyable if you have that idea clearly in mind. So we should make sure it's placed with wizard_finesse and not after purple_wizard_maze.
This is a really good level but maybe very hard for people to figure out what to do .. depends on context of surrounding levels.
